name: Lover Interface
source: A 29-year-old ordinary guy, Ethan Syu works as an on-site computer engineer by day and runs a struggling personal video channel by night. On his way to a filming location, he gets into an accident. When he wakes up the next day, he discovers a mysterious user interface occasionally popping up in his vision, seemingly showing him the affection levels of certain people around him...
